name: Can help with
description: Concerns, conditions and life situations a practitioner can help with. Practitioners pick as many as apply. Clients filter and search by them.
crisisNote: Enso is not an emergency service. If you are in immediate danger or thinking of ending your life, call 112, or Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24x7).

items.label: Anxiety
items.description: Constant worry, restlessness or a feeling that something is about to go wrong.

items.label: Panic attacks
items.description: Sudden waves of intense fear with a racing heart, breathlessness or dizziness.

items.label: Social anxiety
items.description: Fear of being judged, feeling awkward, or avoiding people and social situations.

items.label: Health anxiety
items.description: Persistent worry about being ill, and checking or seeking reassurance about symptoms.

items.label: Phobias & specific fears
items.description: Intense fear of particular things or situations, like flying, heights or needles.

items.label: Overthinking
items.description: Thoughts that loop, replaying conversations or running through every 'what if'.

items.label: Stress
items.description: Feeling stretched thin, tense or unable to switch off.

items.label: Low mood & depression
items.description: Feeling flat, hopeless or tired for weeks, and losing interest in things you used to enjoy.

items.label: Mood swings & intense emotions
items.description: Emotions that shift quickly or feel too big to manage.

items.label: Anger
items.description: Anger that flares quickly, feels hard to control or damages relationships.

items.label: Loneliness
items.description: Feeling isolated or disconnected, even around other people.

items.label: Guilt & shame
items.description: A heavy sense of having done wrong, or of not being good enough as a person.

items.label: Self-esteem & confidence
items.description: A harsh inner critic, self-doubt, or feeling you're never quite enough.

items.label: Identity & self-discovery
items.description: Working out who you are, what you value and where you fit.

items.label: Perfectionism
items.description: Holding yourself to impossible standards and feeling like a failure when you miss them.

items.label: Procrastination & motivation
items.description: Putting things off, feeling stuck or struggling to get started.

items.label: LGBTQIA+ concerns
items.description: Exploring sexuality or gender, coming out, and dealing with stigma or family reactions.

items.label: Cultural & family expectations
items.description: Pressure from family, community or tradition around marriage, career or how to live.

items.label: Meaning & purpose
items.description: Feeling lost or directionless, or questioning what your life is for.

items.label: Personal growth
items.description: Understanding yourself better and growing, even when nothing is 'wrong'.

items.label: Trauma & PTSD
items.description: Living with the after-effects of frightening or overwhelming experiences.

items.label: Childhood experiences
items.description: Making sense of how growing up, and what happened then, still affects you.

items.label: Recovery from abuse
items.description: Recovering from emotional, physical or sexual abuse, now or in the past.

items.label: Grief & loss
items.description: Coping with the death of someone close, or other losses that change your life.

items.label: Relationships
items.description: Communication, trust, conflict or patterns that keep repeating with partners.

items.label: Breakups & divorce
items.description: Getting through the end of a relationship or marriage.

items.label: Marriage & marital conflict
items.description: Arguments, distance, or adjusting to married life together.

items.label: Infidelity & trust
items.description: Rebuilding, or deciding about, a relationship after an affair or broken trust.

items.label: Family conflict
items.description: Tension with parents, siblings or in-laws, and setting boundaries at home.

items.label: Parenting
items.description: Your child's behaviour, your relationship with them, or the stress of being a parent.

items.label: Intimacy & sexual concerns
items.description: Desire, closeness or sexual difficulties, on your own or with a partner.

items.label: Attachment & codependency
items.description: Fear of abandonment, clinging, or losing yourself in relationships.

items.label: People-pleasing & boundaries
items.description: Struggling to say no, or always putting other people's needs first.

items.label: Work stress & burnout
items.description: Exhaustion, cynicism or dread about work that rest doesn't seem to fix.

items.label: Career concerns
items.description: Feeling stuck, choosing a path, job loss or difficulties at work.

items.label: Academic & exam stress
items.description: Pressure around studies, exams, results or competitive entrance tests.

items.label: Life transitions
items.description: Big changes like moving out, a new job, marriage, retirement or becoming a parent.

items.label: Moving & living abroad
items.description: Settling into a new city or country, homesickness and culture shock.

items.label: Financial stress
items.description: Worry about money, debt or financial insecurity, and how it affects you.

items.label: Caregiver stress
items.description: The emotional load of looking after an ill, ageing or disabled family member.

items.label: ADHD
items.description: Trouble with focus, restlessness, impulsivity or getting organised, in children and adults.

items.label: Autism
items.description: Support for autistic people and their families, from understanding to day-to-day life.

items.label: Learning difficulties
items.description: Dyslexia and other difficulties with reading, writing or numbers.

items.label: Developmental delays
items.description: Support when a child is slower to reach milestones in speech, movement or play.

items.label: OCD
items.description: Unwanted, intrusive thoughts and the urges or rituals used to calm them.

items.label: Bipolar disorder
items.description: Periods of very high energy or mood alongside periods of depression.

items.label: Personality disorders
items.description: Long-standing patterns in emotions and relationships, such as borderline personality disorder.

items.label: Psychosis & schizophrenia
items.description: Hearing or seeing things others don't, unusual beliefs, and recovery after an episode.

items.label: Self-harm
items.description: Hurting yourself as a way of coping with overwhelming feelings.

items.label: Suicidal thoughts
items.description: Thoughts of not wanting to be alive, or of ending your life.

items.label: Eating concerns
items.description: A difficult relationship with food, eating or weight.

items.label: Body image
items.description: Distress about how your body looks, or constantly comparing it to others.

items.label: Sleep problems
items.description: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleep that doesn't leave you rested.

items.label: Substance use
items.description: Concerns about alcohol, smoking, cannabis or other substances.

items.label: Screen, gaming & other habits
items.description: Habits like gaming, scrolling, gambling or pornography that feel out of control.

items.label: Chronic illness & pain
items.description: The emotional side of long-term illness, pain or a new diagnosis.

items.label: Ageing & memory
items.description: Adjusting to later life, memory changes, and support for families living with dementia.

items.label: Pregnancy & postpartum
items.description: Emotional ups and downs in pregnancy and after birth, including postpartum depression.

items.label: Fertility & IVF
items.description: The stress of trying to conceive, fertility treatment and the waiting in between.

items.label: Pregnancy loss
items.description: Grieving a miscarriage, stillbirth or termination.

items.label: PMS, PCOS & hormonal health
items.description: Mood changes linked to periods, PMDD, PCOS or other hormonal shifts.

items.label: Menopause
items.description: Mood, sleep and identity changes around perimenopause and menopause.
